title: SpecCert: Automated Quality-Control, Spectroscopy Simulation (UV-Vis TD-DFT, IR/Raman Anharmonic Scaling), and Electronic Structure Certification (DOS & d-Band Center)
description: An open-source scientific toolkit for simulated spectroscopy quality control, TD-DFT UV-Vis line broadening, empirical harmonic-to-anharmonic vibrational frequency scaling for IR and Raman spectra, and electronic density of states (DOS) d-band center calculations.
